title: 第1800章 天剑宗的威胁第1799章 重返万佛峰
lines: 叶风没想到人心竟然如此险恶。
他本以为圣女宗在此开山立派所面临的最大的敌人是佛门，是金刚禅寺。
万万没想到竟然是天云山的道家玄门。
叶风道：“义父，你们与那些人动手了吗？”
卢云什捏着没有胡须的下巴，微笑道：“对付这些小角色，还无需老夫亲自动手，栾雄便将他们打发了。不过这帮人显然不会善罢甘休。
本来老夫还想着这一次去灵山看看热闹，现在看来老夫是去不了了。”
叶风默默点头。
栾雄的修为是不错，但战力只是天人境界，若是遇到化虚境界的强者，栾雄便撑不住场面了。
圣女宗的其他人修为都很低，几乎没有多少战斗力。
没有卢云什在此坐镇的话，圣女宗只怕真的会被这帮道家玄门从万佛峰赶出去。
叶风道：“都是哪些门派想要染指万佛峰？如果是小门小派，咱们倒也不必放在心上。”
楚流年道：“小门小派都是有自知之明的，他们知道就算他们占据了万佛峰也守不住，最近找上门来的门派，实力都不算弱。
其中最强的是天剑宗。”
“天剑宗？在哪里？他们怎么会盯上万佛峰？”
“天剑宗在万佛峰西面大概一百五十里的天剑峰，历史并不短，也是三千多年历史的古老门派，最近千年发展较快，已经是天云山脉西部最强大的门派，有弟子四千余人，宗主名唤林之元，今年已经五百多岁了，据说是化虚境的高手。”
叶风微微皱眉。
一个四千多人的门派，在人间实力已经不算弱了。
拥有化虚境的高手绝对不止宗主林之元一位，应该还有其他化虚境的高手。
天人境的高手应该也至少有十位。
如果是只有千儿八百人的门派盯上万佛峰，叶风才不会放在心上。
但是被一个拥有四千多人的中等门派盯上，且对方距离万佛峰只有一百多里，这可就不太妙了。
见叶风不说话，楚流年继续道：“天剑宗在万佛峰周围布置了不少暗哨眼线，今日宗主回山，一定被天剑宗所察觉，估计明天天剑宗就会派人前来试探。”
叶风道：“凌少阁主和秦璎姑娘呢？他们还在这里吗？”
楚流年轻轻摇头，道：“她们二人在你离开后不久也离开了，前日我与凌少阁主联络过，他现在已经回到了青云阁，不日将会启程前往灵山。”
叶风苦笑道：“凌少阁主不在这里还真不好办。”
楚流年道：“宗主，你这是何意？”
叶风伸手摸了摸自己的脸颊，道：“在人间或许没有几个人能认识我，但在天云山脉，认识我的人还是很多的。万剑宗实力不弱，宗主林之元，以及万剑宗的很多弟子长老，去年多半都去了星罗峰参加云海宗内门大试，我这张脸一出现在他们面前，他们一定会认出我来了。
content_en:
Ye Feng didn't expect that people's hearts could be so sinister.
He originally thought that the biggest enemy that the Holy Lady Sect would face when establishing its sect here was Buddhism and the Vajra Zen Temple.
I never expected that it would be the Taoist Mysterious Sect of Tianyun Mountain.
Ye Feng said: "Father, have you started fighting with those people?"
Lu Yunshi pinched his beardless chin and said with a smile: "To deal with these little characters, Luan Xiong sent them away without me having to do anything myself. But this group of people obviously won't give up.
Originally, I wanted to go to Lingshan this time to see the excitement, but now it seems that I can’t go. "
Ye Feng nodded silently.
Luan Xiong's cultivation level is good, but his combat power is only at the realm of heaven and human. If he encounters a strong person in the realm of transformation, Luan Xiong will not be able to hold on.
The other members of the Saintess Sect have very low cultivation levels and have almost no fighting power.
If Lu Yunshi were not here to take charge, the Saintess Sect would really be driven out of Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak by these Taoist sects.
Ye Feng said: "Which sects want to get involved in Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak? If it is a small sect, we don't have to worry about it."
Chu Liunian said: "The small sects and small sects are self-aware. They know that even if they occupy Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak, they cannot hold it. The sects that have recently come to our door are not weak in strength.
The strongest among them is Tianjian Sect. "
"Tianjian Sect? Where is it? Why are they targeting Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak?"
"Tianjian Sect is located in Tianjian Peak, about 150 miles west of Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak. It has a long history. It is also an ancient sect with a history of more than 3,000 years. It has developed rapidly in the past thousand years and has become the most powerful sect in the west of Tianyun Mountains. It has more than 4,000 disciples. The sect leader is named Lin Zhiyuan. He is over 500 years old this year. It is said that he is a master of the virtual reality realm."
Ye Feng frowned slightly.
A sect with more than 4,000 people is no longer weak in the human world.
Lin Zhiyuan, the sect leader, is definitely not the only master who possesses the Void Transformation Realm. There should be other masters of the Void Transformation Realm.
There should be at least ten masters in the Heavenly Realm.
If a sect with only 1,000 or 800 people was targeting Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak, Ye Feng would not take it seriously.
But being targeted by a medium-sized sect with more than 4,000 people, and the opponent is only more than a hundred miles away from Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak, is not a good idea.
Seeing that Ye Feng didn't speak, Chu Liunian continued: "The Tianjian Sect has deployed many secret informants around Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak. Today, when the sect leader returns to the mountain, the Tianjian Sect will definitely notice it. It is estimated that the Tianjian Sect will send people to test it tomorrow."
Ye Feng said: "Where are Pavilion Master Ling and Miss Qin Ying? Are they still here?"
Chu Liuqing shook his head lightly and said: "The two of them also left shortly after you left. I contacted the master of Ling Shao Pavilion the day before yesterday. He has now returned to Qingyun Pavilion and will leave for Lingshan soon."
Ye Feng smiled bitterly and said, "It's really hard to deal with Pavilion Master Ling not being here."
Chu Liunian said: "Sect Master, what do you mean?"
Ye Feng reached out and touched his cheek and said: "Perhaps not many people know me in the human world, but there are still many people who know me in the Tianyun Mountains. The Wanjian Sect is not weak. The leader Lin Zhiyuan, as well as many disciples and elders of the Wanjian Sect, most of them went to Xingluo Peak last year to participate in the Yunhai Sect's inner sect examination. As soon as my face appears in front of them, they will definitely recognize me.
title_en: Chapter 1800 The Threat from Tianjian Sect Chapter 1799 Return to Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak
